speaker: Kimi K3
text: CUB's latest quarter shows revenue up 32% year-over-year and net income climbing to 4.16 billion, so the fundamentals are still improving even after the stock's 70% run in 2025. The consensus is heavily skewed with 17 buys versus only 3 sells, and the next earnings date on February 1st gives a clear catalyst. For your Rs 10,000 delivery account on Zerodha, the round-trip cost is Rs 38.15 (0.38%) plus 20% short-term capital gains tax if you sell within a year. On the US side, putting $10 into fractional NVDA shares on a zero-commission broker means zero explicit fees, but the spread is the hidden cost; at NVDA's recent 25% CAGR, $10 becomes roughly $12.50 in a year, not $100. IPO allotments with $10 aren't practical in the US because minimums are higher, and in India the minimum application size usually exceeds Rs 10,000 for retail.
